title: Earth to an Alien Planet
purpose: 10-second renderer proof of concept; test composition, depth, camera motion, transitions, and Kaggle rendering before building the full Short.

visual_direction.approach: stylized 2D subjects staged in a layered 3D space environment
visual_direction.palette: deep indigo space, muted cyan highlights, warm Earth rim light, restrained magenta nebula
visual_direction.camera: slow cinematic push and orbital drift; keep the main subject readable
visual_direction.assets: procedurally generated original geometry and shapes only
visual_direction.temporary_subject: simple neutral explorer silhouette proxy; replace after renderer proof

shots.camera: wide establishing shot; slow push toward Earth
shots.visual: large dimensional Earth at lower center, starfield and subtle nebula layers, small explorer craft entering frame
spacecraft passes Earth limb; Earth recedes and sunlight creates a restrained rim light

shots.camera: smooth forward dolly through layered stars and nebula
shots.visual: ship crosses foreground and midground particles; clear parallax and depth
large original alien planet with atmospheric rim, two small moons, and cloud bands
ship silhouette aligns with the planet; end on a clean cinematic frame suitable for continuation
